verdict.rationale: Namecheap has a documented public XML API (with sandbox environment) and official SDKs/tooling (Go SDK, Terraform provider) that let developers/agents programmatically check, register, renew, and lock domains, plus RDAP endpoints for domain lookups — evidence of a genuine programmatic surface beyond a GUI. However, the API is XML-based rather than a modern REST/JSON API, requires whitelisted IPs and API keys (friction for autonomous agents), and there's no evidence of an AI-specific or MCP-style interface. missing for 10: modern REST/JSON API docs, evidence of unrestricted/agent-friendly auth flow, first-party AI-agent integration or MCP server.
